purpose: Reads the stakeholders, the Authority and (on a Development Resource) the Resource Owner of a Plan record from its relations and its text, and holds the rules that a Function Constraint or Solution Constraint names a person as its Authority.
namedChanges: Code verbatim; the header and three doc comments (a round number in front of a sentence) are made generic.

Code verbatim except the imports: `./recordPlane` (`typeLocalName`) is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-curie`; `./relations` (`RecordRelation`) is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-relation-role`; `import { typeFacetKey } from "./workingSetFacets"` is `import { typeKey as typeFacetKey } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-key"` (the call sites are unchanged; the app's `typeFacetKey` asks its type registry first, the unit's default key does not, and `setTypeKey` puts the registry back); `kindDescendants` and the type `StakeholderKindType` of the private package `gilb-stakeholders` are `./kinds`; `StakeholderTypeSet` of `./stakeholderKinds` is `./kinds`; `./planStakeholders` is unchanged.

library.title: Stakeholders, Authority and Resource Owner model
library.note: Pure reading and constraint person rules; the lines on screen are plan-stakeholder-lines. Plan.DevelopmentResource
